newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi condemns Israeli housing move.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi condemns Israeli housing move.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Thursday Israeli plans to build new Jewish housing in Arab East Jerusalem were both astonishing and worrying.
"It's stunning, a cause for concern," he told a news conference after holding talks with Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali on bilateral issues.
Italy and Morocco earlier signed a three-year cultural and scientific cooperation agreement.
Israeli ministers on Wednesday approved the building of a new Jewish neighbourhood of 6,500 homes on land captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
The decision was criticised worldwide amid fears it could spark fresh violence over the holy city of Jerusalem.
